temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had no prior indication that Cheryl was struggling with the project; she likely viewed Cheryl as a capable colleague working on the outreach effort.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria now believes Cheryl is currently overwhelmed and open to receiving assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is stressed by the project workload but appreciates help and is willing to collaborate with Maria.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and compassion, with a helpful and supportive attitude.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria observes Cheryl's improved handling of responsibilities and growing confidence; during the staff meeting Maria suggests Cheryl for leadership, and Cheryl thanks her and accepts the role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved in handling responsibilities and is gaining confidence; she sees Cheryl as capable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria's view is confirmed and strengthened when the team leader supports the suggestion and Cheryl willingly accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is ready and willing to lead the next phase of the project and values Maria's confidence in her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl's leadership in the next phase of the project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately and learns Cheryl was surprised by the leadership suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl is capable and accepted the leadership role, but she worries that her suggestion may have felt like overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria's worry is reduced because Cheryl says she appreciates the support and that Maria's belief means a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl did not feel pressured; she values Maria's support and confidence.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially anxious and worried, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported rather than pressured and to maintain clear, trusting communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project; Cheryl agrees enthusiastically and says Maria's guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her honesty and support after their private conversation, and she feels relieved about their relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns Cheryl wants to co-lead and values their collaboration and Maria's guidance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can effectively co-lead the project by supporting each other as a strong team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects; Maria asks about teaming up for more future projects, and Cheryl says she would love that and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and that they have developed strong synergy and a successful partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; Cheryl's enthusiastic response confirms and deepens Maria's existing belief.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is mutually valued and successful, and they are likely to continue collaborating effectively on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future.
